answer.reason: The verses give one event that happened at this gulf: Solomon built a navy of ships on its shore; the other verses only mention it as a boundary, a stage of a journey, or a place where a cry was heard.

clauses.english: was where King Solomon made a navy of ships
clauses.quote: king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber

doubts: EXO 23:31 (boundary) and JDG 11:16 (a stage of Israel's journey) only mark the place, so they were left out.
JER 49:21 is a figure of speech about Edom's fall, so it was left out.
The Red Sea named in these verses may be the Gulf of Aqaba or the larger sea; only 1KI 9:26 fits the Gulf of Aqaba, near Ezion-geber.
